conceptZh: 一台玩具賽車「咻」地衝過畫面消失，畫面外傳來撞進軟墊的悶悶一聲；接著它用極慢的速度倒車回到畫面中央，保險桿上還黏著一朵被撞下來的小花，它停好、抖了一下，花就掉下來。
morph: the glyph 快 stands still as a solid sculpture while the race car overshoots and reverses back
creativeAngle: 孩子喜歡速度感的車，笑點在於「快得看不見」與「慢得要命的倒車」形成節奏反差，加上保險桿上那朵花的無聲交代，不用畫出撞擊也看得懂。快為豎心旁加夬共七畫，筆畫不多但豎心旁兩點容易糊，維持字體靜止。語音詞「快車」，車ㄔㄜ已學過，兩字都是單一讀音。
promptEn: Create an exactly 8-second 3D stylized toy animation as one continuous locked-off shot on a clean solid pale sky background. One correctly formed Traditional Chinese character 快 stands centered the whole time as a flat-fronted sculpture in saturated deep cherry red, filling about 70% of the frame height with comfortable margins on all sides. Use standard textbook proportions: the upright 忄 radical on the left, with its two dots clearly separated, sits beside the 夬 component on the right with its long sweeping strokes readable. The glyph never moves, rotates, tilts or gets covered, and the camera stays locked. From 0.7 seconds a chunky toy race car streaks in from the left along the base of the glyph and shoots straight out of frame to the right, so fast it is barely more than a stripe. Two beats of empty, silent frame. At 1.8 seconds a soft, muffled boing sounds from off-screen, like a car meeting a very large cushion. Hold the empty frame again. At 2.6 seconds the car reverses back into shot from the right at an absurdly slow, dignified crawl, taking its time all the way to the centre, with one small pink flower now stuck to its front bumper. At 4.0 seconds it parks, settles, and gives a tiny shudder - and the flower drops off onto the floor. The car trundles quietly out of frame to the left by 4.6 seconds, taking the flower with it. From 4.7 seconds to 8.0 seconds the frame is completely still and clean, holding on the single centered 快 with nothing else in shot. Style: Pixar-like glossy chunky toy materials, soft studio lighting, bright high-contrast colors that are vivid but never neon, no dark or moody grading, no white blowouts. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin and says exactly 「快、快、快車」, using the reading ㄎㄨㄞˋ for 快 both on its own and inside the word. Speak the first 快 around 0.5 seconds, the second around 2.0 seconds, and 快車 around 5.6 seconds while the finished glyph is held still, with natural pauses, then stop; do not keep chanting the character or repeat the line. Keep every sound effect soft and clear of the voice, and use no music louder than the voice. The spoken word is audio only and must not be added to the picture. The only writing anywhere in the frame is the single character 快: no subtitles, no vocabulary text, no other letters, numbers, watermarks, scenery, extra props, particles, lens flare, motion blur on the glyph, or flashing effects.
